name: Vorath's Hellheim Throne Room — Scene Guide

text.content:
A ready-to-run boss arena for Vorath, Demon Lord of Helheim (CR 15) — an infernal audience chamber built around fear, fire, and a demon lord who hovers. Everything below uses core Foundry only. Pairs with the Vorath — Phase-by-Phase Encounter Runbook in this pack.

Scene skeleton: grid 100 px = 5 ft, about 46 × 30 squares (230 × 150 ft), darkness level 0.6–0.7 (not fully black — this room glows), global illumination off, darkness color #140604.

How it differs from Umbrathor's Shadow Cavern: the Cavern hides enemies in darkness; the Throne Room shows you exactly what's coming and frightens you anyway.

Perimeter: standard walls, fully wrapped; the party enters at one end and Vorath awaits at the other.

Grand entrance doors (×2 iron, locked): convert to standard walls once the fight starts — Vorath commands the room.

Dais and throne: standard-wall ring with a wide stair gap; Vorath hovers over the throne and his lair actions originate there.

Pillar colonnades (two rows): terrain walls that break sight lines — cover from Hellfire Bolt lanes and escape lanes from his 15-ft Aura of Despair.

Side alcoves (×2–3): thin-walled trophy/bone-pile nooks — melee chokepoints (and where the Zombie shambles out of).

Chasm before the dais (optional): standard walls with a bridging gap. Vorath flies; the party must cross — brutal with Ember Storm.

Key interplay: Vorath hovers at fly 70 ft and has truesight 60 ft — his own smoke and gloom hinder only the party. Token elevation ≈ 15 ft sells the hover.

Smoldering Air (regional effect): wounded creatures take 1d6 fire at turn start; don't add bright light beyond the braziers — the ambient red dimness is the effect.

Watchful Dread: frightened creatures take 1d6 psychic; the fear engine is the fight — mind the 15-ft Aura of Despair radius when placing pillars.

Burning Whispers: long rests in the room fail; no turtling.

Token lights: Vorath 25/60 #b1121f intensity 0.4 slow Pulse — the second-brightest thing in the room, on purpose. Zombie none. PCs only their own light; brazier positions are where the fight actually happens.

Playlist: low organ drone + crackling-fire bed, looped (volume ≈ 0.35), plus one iron-door-slam stinger for the entrance doors locking.

Ember Storm prop: pre-place a hidden 30-ft ambient light (color #ff7a29, animation Chaos, speed 5, intensity 8) centered on the dais; toggle it on when the lair action fires.

Throne of Chains prop: a chain-art tile over the dais with a hidden 10-ft light; reveal when the chains erupt.

Gates of Dread: skip full-screen flashes — instead toggle the hellfire fissure lights to maximum intensity for one round. Cheap and effective.

1. Drop Vorath hovering above the throne (token elevation ≈ 15 ft), and a Zombie in an alcove if you pre-cast Animate Dead.
  2. Tick Inside Lair? on his sheet while the fight is in the throne room, and add a "Lair" combatant at initiative 20 (dnd5e 6.0.x doesn't auto-insert one). Roll one of the five lair actions each round; the Lair Actions (Hellheim Throne Room) banner is the read-aloud script.
  3. Regional effects run passively: Smoldering Air, Watchful Dread, Burning Whispers.
  4. Follow the runbook phases: Dark Burst round 1, aura pressure, the one-slot Cloudkill-vs-Dominate decision at 180 HP, Legendary Resistances saved for save-or-lose, Ember Storm and Throne of Chains in the last third.
  5. Death beat: the braziers flare violet-white, the chains shatter, the throne glow gutters out (kill the throne light), and the regional effects fade over 1d10 days.

Difficulty dials: remove the chasm for melee-heavy parties; pre-animate a second Zombie for strong ones; if the fear engine overwhelms casters, drop Watchful Dread's psychic tick to 1d4.
